capabilities: Build and edit bowtie diagrams in an interactive canvas editor
Add threats, barriers, escalation factors, and per-barrier analysis stacks
Auto-save diagrams as JSON .bowtie files in the vault
Pan, zoom, undo/redo, and inspect nodes via toolbar and context menus
extras: Includes a detailed section on making .bowtie files sync across devices with Obsidian Sync, since custom file extensions are excluded from sync by default; older file formats are migrated automatically.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create or edit bowtie risk-analysis diagrams, which are used in process safety and HSE work to map hazards, threats, barriers, and consequences.

relations.evidence: This plugin bundles html-to-image (MIT) for PNG export.

summary: Visual editor for building and editing risk bowtie diagrams with barriers, escalation factors, analysis stacks, and PNG export.
